info.name: Alwadih Backend API
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for the Alwadih API including Multilingual (ar/en) support, User & Admin Authentication (with 2FA OTP), Password Reset flows, Support Requests, User Preferences, User Profile management, Public Content (FAQ & Privacy Policy), Admin-only Parts, Units, Lessons, Days, Phases & Steps CRUD, and User-only (role: user) Learning Journey progression.

request.description: Root endpoint to verify the API server is up and running. Returns greeting in English or Arabic depending on Accept-Language header.
Registers a new user account, securely hashes the password, generates a 4-digit verification code, and sends it via email in the requested language (ar/en).
Verifies the 4-digit code sent to the user's email upon signup and activates the account.
Generates a fresh 4-digit verification code and resends it to the user's email if the previous code expired or was not received.
Authenticates a user via Google/Gmail. Registers new users automatically with verified status, or logs in existing accounts, returning a signed JWT access token.
Authenticates a verified user and returns a signed JWT access token. Returns 401 Unauthorized if credentials are invalid or if the email is not verified.
Logs out the authenticated user and terminates active sessions by invalidating their JWT tokens via tokenVersion. Requires Bearer authorization.

item.name: 1. Admin Login (Step 1: Check Credentials & Send 2FA OTP)

request.description: Validates administrator credentials and triggers a 4-digit 2FA login verification code sent via email. Does not return an access token.

item.name: 2. Verify Admin Login 2FA OTP (Step 2: Get Token)

exec: console.log('Admin jwt_token saved to collection variables');

request.description: Verifies the 4-digit admin 2FA login code and returns a signed JWT access token (30-minute expiry) with the admin role.
Generates a fresh 4-digit 2FA login verification code and emails it to the admin.
Step 1 of Admin Password Reset. Generates a 4-digit reset code and emails it to the admin.
Resends the 4-digit password reset code to the admin.

exec: console.log('Admin reset_token saved to collection variables');

request.description: Step 2 of Admin Password Reset. Validates the reset code and issues a temporary reset token valid for 15 minutes.
Step 3 of Admin Password Reset. Sets the new password using the valid resetToken.
Step 1 of password reset. Checks that user exists, generates a 4-digit reset code, and emails it.
Generates a fresh 4-digit reset code and resends it if the previous one expired.
Step 2 of password reset. Verifies the 4-digit reset code and generates a temporary resetToken valid for 15 minutes.
Step 3 of password reset. Changes user password using the resetToken obtained in Step 2. Automatically invalidates reset tokens once completed.
Creates a new support request for the authenticated user. Supported categories: 'suggestion', 'technical_issue', 'note'. Supports optional 'idempotencyKey' for duplicate request protection.
Retrieves the authenticated user's preferences. Returns defaults (medium font size, system appearance, ar language, sound true, haptics true) if none exist yet.

Partially updates user preferences via PATCH. Allowed options: fontSize ('small', 'medium', 'large', 'extra large'), appearance ('system', 'dark', 'light'), language ('ar', 'en'), sound (boolean), haptics (boolean).
Retrieves the authenticated user's profile details (id, name, email, avatar, isVerified, createdAt, updatedAt).
Partially updates user profile fields via PATCH (name and/or email). Ensures email uniqueness across other user accounts.
Public endpoint to retrieve published FAQ entries for the specified locale, returned in defined display order with safe structured text and links.
Public endpoint to retrieve the latest published Privacy Policy for the specified locale, including version, effective date, and structured safe sections.

item.name: Learning Journey (User / Mobile)

request.description: [Requires regular User role: user] Retrieves the authenticated user's learning journey road map: parts with availability (isAvailable) and completion status (isCompleted), visited units, and lessons with their days count and progress status (CURRENT, COMPLETED, LOCKED).

query.description: Filters only parts available to the user

request.description: [Requires regular User role: user] Retrieves only the available / unlocked parts for the authenticated user.
[Requires regular User role: user] Retrieves all days belonging to a specific lesson, with each day's progress status: CURRENT, COMPLETED, or LOCKED.

[Requires regular User role: user] Retrieves the details of a specific day including unit hints (unitHintAr, unitHintEn), day status (CURRENT, COMPLETED, LOCKED), and its phases (type, descriptionAr, descriptionEn, phaseId).

[Requires regular User role: user] Retrieves all steps of a specific day across all its phases with layout-typed data. Accessible only if day is CURRENT or COMPLETED (rejects with 403 Forbidden if LOCKED).
[Requires regular User role: user] Marks a specific day as completed for the authenticated user and automatically advances the journey pointer to the next day or lesson.
[Requires regular User role: user] Marks a specific lesson as completed for the authenticated user and automatically advances the journey pointer to the next lesson, unit, or part.
[Requires regular User role: user] Resets the authenticated user's learning journey progress back to the very beginning (Part 1, Unit 1, Lesson 1, Day 1).

item.description: Educational journey endpoints strictly restricted to authenticated regular users (role: user). Admin accounts are forbidden by RolesGuard.

item.name: Arabic Letters

request.description: Public endpoint to retrieve all 28 Arabic letters in standard alphabetical order, each with its tajweed classification type (LATHWI, TAFKHEEM, LATHWI_MUFAKKHAM, TARQEEQ_WA_TAFKHEEM), localized type labels, and audio clip URL.

item.name: 2. Get Arabic Letters Filtered by Type (Public)

query.description: Available types: LATHWI (حروف لثوية), TAFKHEEM (حروف تفخيم), LATHWI_MUFAKKHAM (حرف لثوي مفخم), TARQEEQ_WA_TAFKHEEM (حروف تدور بين الترقيق والتفخيم)

request.description: Public endpoint to retrieve Arabic letters filtered by their phonetic/tajweed classification type.

item.name: 3. Get Arabic Letter By ID or Character (Public)

request.description: Public endpoint to retrieve a single Arabic letter by its MongoDB ObjectId or by its Arabic letter character (e.g. /letters/ث or /letters/{{letter_id}}).
Admin-only endpoint to update or attach an external audio clip URL to an Arabic letter.

item.description: Arabic letters module endpoints including public retrieval of alphabet letters with Tajweed classifications and admin-only audio clip management.
